messages:
evelyn: Hi @people-ops — heads up I'm relocating from SF (US) to London, UK on 2026-10-01. A few quick Qs: 1) WFH stipend — do you convert/pay in GBP or keep USD? 2) payroll/tax withholding steps for international moves? 3) Do benefits/healthcare need active changes? 4) Will this create any UK nexus obligations for Redwood?
people-ops: congrats @evelyn! international moves have a slightly different flow. TL;DR: stipend can be converted to local currency if requested; payroll will need a non-US tax onboarding and we coordinate with Global Mobility & Tax. Benefits often require enrollment updates due to local provider networks. We'll send checklist and form. Please fill the "International Location Change" form: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/international-location-change
evelyn: thanks — timelinewise I need to lock housing by 2026-08-15 and start onboarding w/ new landlord. Any payroll cutoff I should know about?
liam-payroll: Hey @evelyn. For international effective dates we ask for 60 days notice so we can stop US tax withholding and set up any local payroll or contractor arrangements. If you want GBP stipend instead of USD, we need that request by 2026-08-01 to include conversion/FX setup. Also, please include your UK bank details or let us know if you want to remain on US payroll (note: staying on US payroll while physically in UK has tax/immigration implications).
evelyn: ok 60 days is doable. What's the default policy on stipend currency and proration? Do we prorate by days? And do we raise amounts for cost-of-living differences?
people-ops: default: monthly WFH stipend remains $120 USD unless Global Mobility approves a regional adjustment. Proration is by calendar days in the month for the month of move. If you elect GBP payment, we use the company-negotiated FX rate at the payroll cutoff and gross up the amount to the nearest penny. Requests for regional adjustments (e.g., London higher stipend) go through your manager + Global Mobility; that isn't automatic.
evelyn: good to know. what about equity vesting tax withholding and payroll reporting?
amir-taxes: tag from tax team: for US equity holders moving abroad, withholding can change based on residency status and tax treaties. We usually keep RSU withholding on US payroll until residency is established, but this is case-by-case. Please submit form and we'll schedule a short consult with tax. Also: individual moves rarely trigger company nexus in a country; nexus is determined by sustained presence and business activity. We'll monitor aggregate headcount and activity in the UK and advise if anything changes.
evelyn: appreciate that. Anything I need to tell my manager or the hiring team?
people-ops: ask your manager to acknowledge the move on the form and confirm whether you'll remain on any US-engagements that require time overlap. Also cc Global Mobility: global-mobility@redwood.com so they can review visa/immigration concerns.
evelyn: done — form submitted, attached provisional lease and passport scan. indicated GBP stipend and UK bank pending.
liam-payroll: received. We'll proceed with the GBP setup request and reach out if we need proof of bank. Expect a payroll cutover discussion call next week to confirm dates.
global-mobility: thanks for the heads up @evelyn. We'll coordinate on visa timing and check any impact on benefits (especially medical coverage) — may require converting to international plan or local coverage. We'll DM for a quick sync.
evelyn: thank you all — saved! :airplane::uk:
